statement.zh: 晚前王朝至早王朝阶段，上埃及中心（如希拉孔波利斯、阿拜多斯/提尼斯区、纳卡达）与下埃及/三角洲遗址（如布托）在物质文化与制度形成上被现代综合作为互动网络讨论——而非单一「战役征服」叙事。
statement.en: From late Predynastic into Early Dynastic times, Upper Egyptian centers (e.g. Hierakonpolis, Abydos/Thinite region, Naqada) and Lower Egyptian/Delta sites (e.g. Buto) are discussed in modern syntheses as interacting networks of material culture and institution-building — not as a single battle-conquest narrative.
